Definition
[Dedekind zeta function and quadratic symbol] \group arithmetic-volume Source: thurston:page-0182, thurston:page-0183

For $K$ with ring of integers $\mathcal O_K$, \[ \zeta _K(s)=\sum _{\mathfrak a}\frac1{N(\mathfrak a)^s}=\prod _{\mathfrak p}(1-N(\mathfrak p)^{-s})^{-1}. \] The quadratic symbol $\left(\frac{-D}{n}\right)$ is completely multiplicative, is $0$ for primes dividing $D$, is $1$ at $n=1$, and for odd primes records whether $-D$ is a quadratic residue modulo $p$; at $p=2$ it is $+1$ for $-D\equiv 1\pmod8$ and $-1$ for $-D\equiv 5\pmod8$.
